# IMovementRules.Reset method

For [`Movement`](../../ModRunners.Api/IGame/Movement.md): resets every value to the game's defaults. For a runner's own values: the runner follows [`Movement`](../../ModRunners.Api/IGame/Movement.md) again for every value.
